name: Essaouira
blurb: Posts about Essaouira highlight its coastal atmosphere, local seafood preparation at the port, and notable populations of stray cats. Visitors frequently note the city's windy Atlantic weather contrasted with inland heat.

positive: Fresh fish grilled to order at the port stalls
Friendly locals and walkable narrow streets in the medina
Pleasant cooler coastal temperatures compared to nearby Marrakech
negative: Mass tourism bringing crowds of tour buses and guided groups

quotes.text: At the port in Essaouira the fish stalls work like this: you pick your catch from the ice, and the grill spots cook it right there with salt, cumin and lemon. You eat it with bread, hands only, watching the boats rock. Go early, the best fish goes fast.

Marrakech hits 38°C in September. Drive 3 hours west to Essaouira and you're suddenly in 24°C with Atlantic wind. Same country, same month, completely different trip. Morocco's temperature gradient is no joke.

#MoroccoTravel #WeatherPlanning
See also Essaouira in Morocco. I sat at a cafe for a snack and had two cats asleep on my knee and one asleep in my bag before my drink arrived.

Why is mass tourism so depressing ?
From my roof terrace in Essaouira, I look down on the endless tourist mini buses disgorging herds of ill informed, gullible, mostly over weight, miserable looking europeans into the not so tender grasp of a bunch of greedy Moroccan tourist guides.
Thats why !
